value: On: the events show as set on their tabs. Off: the game decides by its own dates, as without the mod; your settings are kept for when you switch it back on.

value: By date (Auto): Halloween on the game's own dates (24 October to 7 November), or on your own dates below. Always (On): every day. Never (Off): no Halloween at all, decorations, ghost and zombie head included, whatever they are set to. Otherwise each of those follows this (With Halloween) or is set to Always or Never on its own.
english: By date (Auto): Halloween on the game's own dates (24 October to 7 November), or on your own dates below. Always (On): every day. Never (Off): no Halloween at all, decorations, ghost and zombie head included, whatever they are set to. Otherwise each of those follows this (With Halloween) or is set to Always or Never on its own.

value: By date (Auto) only: the first day of the event as month-day, e.g. 10-01. Empty: the game's own dates (24 October to 7 November). Needs the last day too.
english: By date (Auto) only: the first day of the event as month-day, e.g. 10-01. Empty: the game's own dates (24 October to 7 November). Needs the last day too.

value: By date (Auto) only: the last day of the event as month-day, e.g. 11-30 (it may wrap past the new year, e.g. 12-20 to 01-06). Empty: the game's own dates. Needs the first day too.
english: By date (Auto) only: the last day of the event as month-day, e.g. 11-30 (it may wrap past the new year, e.g. 12-20 to 01-06). Empty: the game's own dates. Needs the first day too.
note: Halloween, a text box: its description

value: The decorations (pumpkins, garlands, scarecrows, candles, bats) in the village, the port, the dungeons, your grounds and most interiors. With Halloween (Event): while Halloween is on. Always (On): every day, whatever the date. Never (Off): not at all. Halloween set to Never turns them off whatever this says.
english: The decorations (pumpkins, garlands, scarecrows, candles, bats) in the village, the port, the dungeons, your grounds and most interiors. With Halloween (Event): while Halloween is on. Always (On): every day, whatever the date. Never (Off): not at all. Halloween set to Never turns them off whatever this says.

value: The ghost that walks through the village at night (and any other script the game runs for Halloween). With Halloween (Event): while Halloween is on. Always (On): every day. Never (Off): not at all. Halloween set to Never turns it off whatever this says. Takes effect at its next step or evening.
english: The ghost that walks through the village at night (and any other script the game runs for Halloween). With Halloween (Event): while Halloween is on. Always (On): every day. Never (Off): not at all. Halloween set to Never turns it off whatever this says. Takes effect at its next step or evening.

value: Zombies with one particular head get the game's Halloween zombie head instead. With Halloween (Event): while Halloween is on. Always (On): every day. Never (Off): not at all. Halloween set to Never turns it off whatever this says. Pictures already drawn change when the game redraws them (e.g. the next load).
english: Zombies with one particular head get the game's Halloween zombie head instead. With Halloween (Event): while Halloween is on. Always (On): every day. Never (Off): not at all. Halloween set to Never turns it off whatever this says. Pictures already drawn change when the game redraws them (e.g. the next load).
